chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sees only good.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about how Allah perceives all things?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) to elucidate the concept of *al-Hasan* (the Good) as Allah’s exclusive attribute, distinguishing His perfect perception from human limited views. This hadith underscores the Shia theological principle that all creation, in its essence, reflects divine goodness, even if perceived as flawed by humans, thereby reinforcing *tawakkul* (trust) in God’s ultimate wisdom.
